DevopsPipelnStgProm.name: DevopsPipelnStgProm
DevopsPipelnStgProm.description: Represents a stage promotion in DevOps Center. Stage promotion moves one or more work items to the next stage in the pipeline.

CompletionDate.description: The date and time when the stage promotion operation was completed.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.description: A unique name for the pipeline stage promotion record.

PipelineStageId.description: The ID of the target pipeline stage to which the work items are promoted.

RequestInfoId.description: The ID of the associated DevopsRequestInfo record that tracks this event.

Status.description: The current state of the promotion operation.
